I'm on Claude ultra
Heavy use of multi sub agents
I tell them to research, collect info,find best way to achieve the best result and they implement, each agent responsible for a single part then brought together and reviewed, if it fails, back to the drawing board.
On minimum they run for an hour. Each agent
